learner.title: Learner Plan
learner.description: Perfect for individual learners or small pilots. Includes 5 interactive packages, 1 creator, and 1 learner seat. Get started with AI-powered learning at an affordable price.

teacher.title: Teacher Plan
teacher.description: Designed for small classrooms or teams. Includes 10 interactive packages, 1 creator, and 10 learner seats. Empower your group with engaging AI-driven courses.

school.title: School Plan
school.description: Best for schools or larger organizations. Includes 25 interactive packages, 2 creators, and 25 learner seats. Scale AI-powered education across your institution.
